segments.text: ALmightie God whiche by thy ſonne Ieſus Chriſt haſt geuen to thy Apoſtle ſayncte Peter many excellente giftes, and commaundedſt him earneſtly to fede thy flocke: make we beſeche thee, all byſhops and paſtors diligently to preache thy holy worde, and the people obedientlye to folowe the ſame, that they may receyue the croune of euerlaſting Glorye, through Ieſus Chriſt our Lorde.
